main_text.p: pro Catholicis. Mitto Hermanni ac Hosij (sub Swinckfeldij fortassis nomine) blasphemias : Mitto horrendam glossematis illius turpissimi impietatem, quod Salomonis textum à Papæ canonizatione fidem suam mutuari docet: Instar omnium, erit ipse Bellarminus ; qui septenarium Sacramentorum numerum Concilij Tridentini authoritate (hæc enim illis Iun. Animad. in Bell. de verbo Dei ser. ἀγωγὴ ) suffulturus ; Omnium inquit Conciliorum veterum, & omnium dogmatum firmitas pendet ab authoritate præsentis Ecclesiæ : Et paulò ante; Si tollamus authoritatem præ-Glossin decretal. l.2. Tit. 23.Bellar. de num. & effect. Sacr. l.2.c.25.p.300.

page.notes: Greek word in the text (ἀγωγὴ-like, printed as "ἰεϱὰ ἀγωγὴ") is doubtful; marginal notes are printed in italic and partly abbreviated. The column ends mid-word at "præ-" and continues on the next page as "sentis".
